d: The square of the village; at the bottom of the sea, on the front of a fountain, around which the Acquaiole put in turn their orciuoli; on the right, you can see the interior of the house of Matilde: a modest room, full of laundry, with an old Madonna to a wall; on the left the houses of the village; it is day.
Matilde, in his room, with great sadness.
The Choir and Renzo, on the square. Silvano and Matilde, in Matilde's house.

A solitary part of the beach. On the left a steep and jagged cliff. Some boats, far away. To the right, a few meters from the shore, a large rock, to which is moored the new boat of Renzo. It is the sunset.
A bunch of women, then another one.
Silvano alone, then Matilde and Renzo.

It is inserted at the end of Silvano's air "S'es extinguished the sun over there far, in the fourth scene, replacing the caption "stops suddenly, listening" with the following: "he goes out continuing to sing: his song is lost in the distance" .
